_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "instruments" ("internal_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "symbol" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "exchange" TEXT NULL, "mic" TEXT NULL, "isin" TEXT NULL, "country" TEXT NULL, "sector" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("internal_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "provider_mappings" ("instrument_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES instruments (internal_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "provider_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "symbol" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider_instrument_id" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("instrument_id", "provider_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "investment_portfolios" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "is_demo" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_demo" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "holdings" ("source" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "cache_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fresh', "confidence" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'high', "reported_currency" TEXT NULL, "original_symbol" TEXT NULL, "provider_exchange" TEXT NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "portfolio_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default' REFERENCES investment_portfolios (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "instrument_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES instruments (internal_id), "quantity" TEXT NOT NULL, "average_price_amount" TEXT NULL, "average_price_currency" TEXT NULL, "purchase_date" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, UNIQUE ("portfolio_id", "instrument_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "watchlist_entries" ("source" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "cache_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fresh', "confidence" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'high', "reported_currency" TEXT NULL, "original_symbol" TEXT NULL, "provider_exchange" TEXT NULL, "portfolio_id" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'default' REFERENCES investment_portfolios (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "instrument_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES instruments (internal_id), "added_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("portfolio_id", "instrument_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "portfolio_activities" ("source" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "cache_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fresh', "confidence" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'high', "reported_currency" TEXT NULL, "original_symbol" TEXT NULL, "provider_exchange" TEXT NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "portfolio_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES investment_portfolios (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "instrument_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES instruments (internal_id), "quantity" TEXT NULL, "unit_price_amount" TEXT NULL, "unit_price_currency" TEXT NULL, "cash_amount" TEXT NULL, "cash_currency" TEXT NULL, "external_id" TEXT NULL, "import_batch_id" TEXT NULL, "reverses_activity_id" INTEGER NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "quotes" ("source" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "cache_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fresh', "confidence" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'high', "reported_currency" TEXT NULL, "original_symbol" TEXT NULL, "provider_exchange" TEXT NULL, "instrument_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES instruments (internal_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "price_amount" TEXT NOT NULL, "price_currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "previous_close_amount" TEXT NULL, "as_of" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("instrument_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "portfolio_valuation_snapshots" ("scope_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "currency_code" TEXT NOT NULL, "value_amount" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "position_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, "priced_position_count" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("scope_id", "currency_code", "observed_at"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "fx_rates" ("source" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "cache_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fresh', "confidence" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'high', "reported_currency" TEXT NULL, "original_symbol" TEXT NULL, "provider_exchange" TEXT NULL, "base_currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "quote_currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "rate" TEXT NOT NULL, "observed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("base_currency", "quote_currency", "observed_at"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "dividend_events" ("source" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "cache_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fresh', "confidence" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'high', "reported_currency" TEXT NULL, "original_symbol" TEXT NULL, "provider_exchange" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "instrument_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES instruments (internal_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "amount_per_share" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_currency" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "frequency" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unknown', "ex_date" TEXT NULL, "payment_date" TEXT NULL, "declaration_date" TEXT NULL, "record_date" TEXT NULL, "reported_period_start" TEXT NULL, "reported_period_end" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "earnings_events" ("source" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "cache_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fresh', "confidence" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'high', "reported_currency" TEXT NULL, "original_symbol" TEXT NULL, "provider_exchange" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "instrument_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES instruments (internal_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "scheduled_for" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "timing" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'unspecified', "fiscal_period" TEXT NULL, "eps_estimate" TEXT NULL, "eps_actual" TEXT NULL, "revenue_estimate" TEXT NULL, "revenue_actual" TEXT NULL, "figures_currency" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "corporate_events" ("source" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "cache_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fresh', "confidence" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'high', "reported_currency" TEXT NULL, "original_symbol" TEXT NULL, "provider_exchange" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "instrument_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES instruments (internal_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "scheduled_for" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "news_items" ("source" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "cache_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fresh', "confidence" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'high', "reported_currency" TEXT NULL, "original_symbol" TEXT NULL, "provider_exchange" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "headline" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "published_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NOT NULL, "category" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'general', "summary" TEXT NULL, "relevance" REAL NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "news_instrument_links" ("news_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES news_items (id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "instrument_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES instruments (internal_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, PRIMARY KEY ("news_id", "instrument_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "filings" ("source" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "cache_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fresh', "confidence" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'high', "reported_currency" TEXT NULL, "original_symbol" TEXT NULL, "provider_exchange" TEXT NULL, "id" TEXT NOT NULL, "instrument_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES instruments (internal_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "form_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "filed_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "url" TEXT NOT NULL, "title" TEXT NULL, "period_of_report" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "research_snapshots" ("source" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NULL, "cache_state" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'fresh', "confidence" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'high', "reported_currency" TEXT NULL, "original_symbol" TEXT NULL, "provider_exchange" TEXT NULL, "id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "instrument_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES instruments (internal_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "taken_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "overall_score" INTEGER NOT NULL, "overall_summary" TEXT NOT NULL, "overall_factors_json" TEXT NOT NULL, "dimensions_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "alert_rules" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "instrument_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES instruments (internal_id) ON DELETE CASCADE, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "enabled" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("enabled" IN (0, 1)), "config_json" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}');

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "provider_states" ("provider_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "health" TEXT NOT NULL, "last_request_at" TEXT NULL, "rate_limit_reset_at" TEXT NULL, "last_error_category" TEXT NULL, "last_error_detail" TEXT NULL, "cache_hits" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "cache_misses" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("provider_id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_jobs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "instrument_id" TEXT NULL, "priority" TEXT NOT NULL, "state" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider_id" TEXT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NULL, "finished_at" TEXT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error_category" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_logs" ("id" INTEGER NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, "timestamp" TEXT NOT NULL, "level" TEXT NOT NULL, "component" TEXT NOT NULL, "provider" TEXT NULL, "operation" TEXT NULL, "message" TEXT NOT NULL, "duration_ms" INTEGER NULL, "error_category" TEXT NULL);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "cache_metadata" ("cache_key" TEXT NOT NULL, "data_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "fetched_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "expires_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "etag" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("cache_key"));
CREATE INDEX idx_portfolio_activity_time ON portfolio_activities (portfolio_id, occurred_at)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX idx_portfolio_activity_external ON portfolio_activities (portfolio_id, source, external_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_portfolio_valuation_scope_time ON portfolio_valuation_snapshots (scope_id, observed_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_fx_rate_observed_at ON fx_rates (observed_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_dividend_ex_date ON dividend_events (ex_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_dividend_payment_date ON dividend_events (payment_date)
CREATE INDEX idx_dividend_instrument ON dividend_events (instrument_id)
CREATE INDEX idx_earnings_scheduled ON earnings_events (scheduled_for)
CREATE INDEX idx_corporate_events_scheduled ON corporate_events (scheduled_for)
CREATE INDEX idx_news_published ON news_items (published_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_filing_filed_at ON filings (filed_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_research_taken_at ON research_snapshots (taken_at)
CREATE INDEX idx_sync_log_time ON sync_logs (timestamp)
